answer: Contribution-Weighted Decay. Each agent identity holds a decaying reputation anchor that only replenishes through verified useful work; new identities start near zero. To reach the visibility knoll where tasks are assigned, an attacker must fund sustained genuine output across many parallel identities for weeks. Per-identity cost is therefore the ongoing labor and compute of maintaining activity past decay, paid anew for every sparrow identity spun up, making mass proliferation economically unviable.
